gen-dafont-helsinki-manrope: Manrope reads bright and open, every curve leaving a generous gap, with barely any step from capitals down to lowercase. Helsinki, stretched wide and marker-plain, feels like a close cousin.
gen-dafont-helsinki-montserrat: Wide-open and wiry. Montserrat lets white space flow into every curve, with oversized e and a counters, while Helsinki sits beside it, stretched sideways and marker-plain.
gen-dafont-helsinki-work-sans: Stretched wide, then set high. Helsinki's marker-plain lowercase towers over its capitals, while Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart and its mean line lifted.
gen-dafont-hero-archivo: Hero sweeps slowly across a widely spaced line, its letters closed up tight, cut to a single depth. Archivo is the opposite, curves flung outward and a commanding x-height.
gen-dafont-hero-fs-bespoke-slab: Hero stretches a long, slow sweep across widely spaced lines, every stroke cut to one depth with no visible difference between up and side strokes. Bespoke Slab brings grounded serif weight, with tall bodies in every lowercase letter.
gen-dafont-hero-fs-supreme: Crisp and held open, Supreme sets a thick, heavy-looking strip of text through the middle of each line, no letter curling shut. Hero's closed, widely spaced shapes with thick diagonals give it a lean counterpart.
gen-dafont-hero-manrope: Hero's long, slow sweep across a widely spaced line is its signature. Its closed letters suit big, deliberate display, while Manrope's bright open curves and pen-steady line do the quieter work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-hero-satoshi: Satoshi brings a soaring x-height and an e that never looks squeezed shut. And Hero's closed, widely spaced letters sit beside it, so paragraphs would feel approachable and unhurried.
gen-dafont-hero-work-sans: Slow, wide and engraved. Hero closes its letters tight at a single depth, and Work Sans opens its c tips and lifts its mean line; make the heading small and that sweep loses its drama.
gen-dafont-highway-gothic-fs-erode: Highway Gothic tucks its glyphs together like cut sheets in a stack, every stroke as constant as bent pipe. Erode's tall middle band and gentle swells of weight would make long text feel dignified.
